description: DEL-04-09 I3a (Design §5.3): the modal result reader corpus. Each entry applies its operations to a committed modal fixture (replace, add, scale, scale_rows, withhold, remove_rows with renumbering), or raw `text_operations` on its committed text (for what a parsed value cannot carry: duplicate members, non-JSON numbers), reseals every row checksum and table digest when `reseal` is true, supplies the request when named (after its own operations), and states the standing it targets (`intent`) and, for the adversarial entries, a phrase its difference must contain (`difference_contains`); every entry is read through each reader's checked text entry. `expected` is the verdict both readers must return: tests/test_modal_evidence.py and core/reporting/modal_result/tests/corpus.rs.
